files.summary: reuse delivered invention revisions, readiness and approvals; retain only missing project and generated-art coordination
edits:
- [ ] **9.1 Extend the delivered revision boundary to the wider project.** WW18–WW23 already save immutable submitted revisions, select the current draft, retain source-quoted human requirements and create an exact review plan through the existing authoring session. Reuse those records and the original request/root lineage for a creative objective spanning supported views and deliberately funded sessions; add only the missing project-wide selection and mechanical/visual coordination. Retain separate active definition/install/visual identities. Preserve expected-revision rejection and the existing single-child claim; do not introduce another writable draft store or last-write-wins editing.
- [ ] **9.2 Extend shared editing views.** The current owner conversation, saved-draft reader, revision comparison and human review already use the same authoritative revisions. Connect the remaining forms and authorized technical editing to that boundary, including appearance-only, function-only and combined requests. Retain a selected silhouette/material when requested. Summaries and generated briefs must derive from the draft rather than become alternate state.
- [ ] **9.3 Coordinate independent work branches.** Extend the delivered finite preparation record, which already separates native admission, required references and presentation availability; its fallback check is not a generated-art job or independent visual review. Add the missing independently progressing mechanical/visual work and keep active installation and review grants distinct. Record eligible dependent jobs durably, execute them outside the world mutation transaction, and fence publication by selected revision and authority. No full cross-product status enum or new workflow service is required.
- [ ] **9.5 Extend structured repair findings and bounded re-entry.** Preserve delivered `needs_revision`, `pending_analysis`, `blocked` and `ready_for_review` outcomes with retained requirements and native findings. Extend that owner to local output defects, upstream design contradictions, unknown evidence, unsupported host behavior, provider uncertainty and current-runtime faults; do not recreate the finite preparation planner. Changed designs re-enter one validation planner while retaining reusable work; local art defects do not regenerate mechanics. Require acceptance of substantive substitutions and preserve failed findings/liked outputs.
- [ ] **9.6 Extend exact review without weakening current approval.** Ordinary finite recipe admission has its separate automatic path; the delivered owner-authoring session requires exact human approval before its first live write and rechecks the saved candidate, dependencies and authority at Apply. Reuse that boundary for the missing art/conjure/law scope and independent visual approval. Lower-impact automatic approval inside an owner session remains INV-18.2, not permission to bypass current human review. Stale approvals cannot activate newer/stronger candidates. Reads and harmless draft/validation operations still need no repeated modal confirmation.
- [ ] **9.7 Extend progress and continuation across the wider project.** Reuse delivered draft/review/Apply and structured-question states. Add the missing coordinated-art, undo/reselect and fork journey without inventing a second conversation or receipt store. Players see usable versus draft/blocked, required decisions, pending art and abstract remaining usage; detailed charges remain owner-only under [runtime allocation](../world-agent-runtime.md#1-product-decisions). Preserve private NPC feedback and separate native craft/use. Continuation keeps lineage and current authority rather than erasing cost or reviving old work.
- [ ] **12.1 Extend the finite presentation record.** Current preparation already records native fallback adequacy or no-new-asset against the exact candidate and dependencies; it does not create a generated visual artifact or independently reviewed presentation contract. Extend that owner with versioned function/observable/cosmetic constraints, pinned references, supported states, dimensions/camera/density, pivots/attachments, outputs and bounds from the candidate. Keep renderer details and live instance state separate. Classify meaningful appearance changes through INV-9/11 rather than trust a cosmetic label.
- [ ] **12.2 Qualify fallback adequacy for each added family/state.** Existing finite recipes already use named native inventory/tool representations and the other current adapters require no new asset. Reuse those paths, native family composition and supported state effects without inference, rather than rebuilding current presentation. Prove any additional required cues per family and state; a trap or doorway needs more than the existing generic inventory representation. Use independent visual randomness. Missing required representation blocks the affected live surface, not unrelated valid mechanics.
